claim: Recent DAU YoY acceleration accompanies a larger MAU term with current-period growth and prior-period base effects and a smaller positive frequency-proxy term
data_inputs: M001 M002 M008 by comparable quarter; stage3_base_period_bridge.csv
calculation: 100 ln DAU growth = 100 ln MAU growth + 100 ln ratio growth; YoY change equals current QoQ log growth minus prior-year QoQ log growth
evidence_strength: Official values plus reproducible identities; direction survives 256 rounding corners; three base bridges independently recalculated; no causal attribution
alternative_explanation: Prior-year MAU contraction contributes to higher YoY term; marketing reactivation and user or subject mix also change aggregate reach
disconfirming_check: Compare current and reactivated cohorts with exposure and assignment; ratio is not retention; do not treat base effects as feature uplift
decision_impact: Separate effective speaking and transfer from aggregate engagement in H1/H2; retain growth as context rather than Stage4 effect parameter
unresolved_data: Target cohort events and randomized outcomes

claim: AI efficiency statements do not establish cost or net value at wider speaking eligibility
data_inputs: Product timeline and company cost commentary
calculation: No per-call cost estimate or attribution formula

disconfirming_check: Measure effective minutes and incremental variable costs with billing and tier substitution
decision_impact: Keep H3 conditional; Stage4 tests cost and adoption and substitution ranges
